evidence.title: Optimum Invests $6 Million to Strengthen Network in Lubbock, Texas | ATUS Stock News

occurrences.checkable_against: Optimum network performance and coverage records in Lubbock
occurrences.quote_span: This upgrade enhances performance across the city, supporting residential neighborhoods, small businesses, fire stations, and essential public facilities with greater speed, reliability, and resilience.
occurrences.speaker: Optimum
occurrences.subject: Optimum

occurrences.checkable_against: Optimum grant records and Boys & Girls Clubs of Lubbock grant receipt records
occurrences.quote_span: To support the local community, Optimum will present the Boys & Girls Clubs of Lubbock with a $5,000 technology grant.
occurrences.speaker: Optimum
occurrences.subject: Optimum

occurrences.checkable_against: Amanda Seabaugh's statement or the Optimum news release transcript
occurrences.quote_span: “Reliable connectivity is essential to how people live and work today,” said Amanda Seabaugh, Vice President, General Manager of Optimum Texoma and West Pac.
occurrences.speaker: Amanda Seabaugh
occurrences.subject: Optimum

occurrences.checkable_against: Optimum Lubbock residential network performance and service reliability records
occurrences.quote_span: For residents, it means a better online experience – smoother streaming, faster downloads, and more reliable connections for work, school, and everyday use across multiple devices.
occurrences.speaker: Optimum
occurrences.subject: Optimum

occurrences.checkable_against: Optimum Lubbock business-network service specifications and performance records
occurrences.quote_span: For local businesses, the enhanced network provides the speed and scalability needed to support day-to-day operations, cloud applications, and future growth.
occurrences.speaker: Optimum
occurrences.subject: Optimum

occurrences.checkable_against: Councilwoman Christy Martinez-Garcia's statement or the event/news release transcript
occurrences.quote_span: “This investment in Lubbock will benefit all of our residents, especially our children who will now be better equipped to compete in today's high-tech world.”
occurrences.speaker: Councilwoman Christy Martinez-Garcia
occurrences.subject: Optimum

occurrences.checkable_against: Optimum Lubbock network construction and fiber-route records
occurrences.quote_span: As part of this investment, Optimum built an approximately 100-mile fiber ring that powers the backbone of its local network.
occurrences.speaker: Optimum
occurrences.subject: Optimum

occurrences.checkable_against: Optimum and Bayless Elementary grant records
occurrences.quote_span: Earlier this week, Optimum presented Bayless Elementary with a $10,000 grant to expand STEM learning opportunities for students.
occurrences.speaker: Optimum
occurrences.subject: Optimum

occurrences.checkable_against: Amanda Seabaugh's statement or the Optimum news release transcript
occurrences.quote_span: “This investment strengthens our network in Lubbock and ensures we’re delivering the fast, dependable service our customers count on every day.”
occurrences.speaker: Amanda Seabaugh
occurrences.subject: Optimum

occurrences.checkable_against: Bayless Elementary and Lubbock Independent School District plans, event records, robotics-program records, and science-equipment purchasing records
occurrences.quote_span: The school, part of Lubbock Independent School District, plans to use the funding to host a STEM Family Engagement Night in the spring, launch an after-school robotics program and provide hands-on science lab equipment for students in kindergarten through fifth grade.
occurrences.speaker: Bayless Elementary
occurrences.subject: Optimum

occurrences.checkable_against: Boys & Girls Clubs of Lubbock computer-lab upgrade records and grant expenditure records
occurrences.quote_span: The investment will help modernize the Club's computer lab through new technology upgrades and refreshed learning spaces, creating an engaging environment where members can build valuable digital and STEM skills.
occurrences.speaker: Optimum
occurrences.subject: Optimum

occurrences.checkable_against: Optimum announcement or project completion records for the Lubbock network investment
occurrences.quote_span: Optimum, a leading provider of internet, mobile, and TV services, today announced the completion of a $6 million investment to strengthen its network in Lubbock – delivering faster, more reliable connectivity for residents, businesses, and key community institutions.
occurrences.speaker: Optimum
occurrences.subject: Optimum

occurrences.checkable_against: Councilwoman Christy Martinez-Garcia's statement or the event/news release transcript
occurrences.quote_span: “Strong digital infrastructure is essential for attracting investment, supporting local businesses, and keeping our community connected,” said Councilwoman Christy Martinez-Garcia.
occurrences.speaker: Councilwoman Christy Martinez-Garcia
occurrences.subject: Optimum
